label: Person
definition: A party that is a natural person.

label: Organization
definition: A party that is an organization, such as a company, a partnership or a public body.

label: Sold-To
definition: The role of the party that buys: it places the order and is the party the sale is made to.

label: Payer
definition: The role of the party that pays the invoices of an account.

label: Bill-To
definition: The role of the party that receives the invoices of an account.

label: Consignee
definition: The role of the party that receives the delivered product.

label: Jobber
definition: The role of an independent reseller that buys branded fuel under a supply agreement and owns or operates its outlets.

label: Dealer
definition: The role of a party that operates a branded site under a direct agreement with the company.

label: Exchange Counterparty
definition: The role of a party that swaps product with the company, or buys and sells with it, under an exchange or buy-sell agreement.

label: Throughput Holder
definition: The role of a party that moves or stores volumes under a throughput, storage or transport agreement.

label: Carrier
definition: The role of a party that transports product for a lifting or a movement.

label: Vendor
definition: The role of a party that sells goods or services to the company.

label: Surety
definition: The role of a party that guarantees another party's obligations, such as payment.

label: Supplier
definition: The role of a party that supplies product to the company.

label: Position Holder
definition: The role of the party that owns the product position from which a lifting at a terminal is drawn.

label: Loading-Authorized Party
definition: The role of a party that is allowed to lift product at a terminal. The role is held for a period; the permission that grants it is a separate record.

label: parent of
definition: One role's party is the parent of the other's, for example a parent company and a subsidiary.

label: guarantor of
definition: One role guarantees the other's obligations.

label: supplies
definition: One role supplies product to the other.

label: credit roll-up
definition: One role's credit exposure is counted under the other's for credit limits and reviews.

label: contact for
definition: One role is the contact for the other.

label: Fuel Supply
definition: An agreement under which the company supplies fuel, as a branded jobber, direct dealer or unbranded term agreement.

label: Exchange / Buy-Sell
definition: An agreement to swap product barrel for barrel or to buy and sell product with a counterparty.

label: Throughput / Storage
definition: An agreement to move or store a party's volumes through pipelines, terminals or tanks.

label: Brand License
definition: An agreement that grants a party the right to use a brand for a period.

label: Consignment / Commission
definition: An agreement under which the company keeps ownership of product held at a party's site, which sells it for a commission.

label: Fleet Card Program
definition: An agreement that lets a party's vehicles buy fuel with a fleet card.

label: Offtake
definition: An agreement to take product from a source in agreed volumes over a period.

label: Brand
definition: The line of business that sells branded fuel to jobbers, dealers and their sites.

label: Unbranded
definition: The line of business that sells fuel without a brand.

label: Asphalt
definition: The line of business that sells asphalt.

label: Petrochemicals
definition: The line of business that sells petrochemical products.

label: SDP
definition: A line of business named SDP. The decision owner chose to keep the label without an expansion (EPM-DEC-001-0067).

label: Renewable Fuels
definition: The line of business that sells renewable fuels.

label: Cardlock
definition: The line of business that sells fuel at unattended cardlock sites, to customers who pay by card.

label: Producers
definition: The line of business that serves oil and gas producers.

label: Pipeline L&S
definition: The line of business that serves pipeline customers of the logistics and storage business. L&S is Logistics and Storage (MPLX FY2023 Form 10-K).

label: Misc
definition: The line of business for customers that fit no other line.

label: Brand-attached resellers
definition: The customer classes that resell fuel under a company brand.

label: Wholesale and unbranded
definition: The customer classes that buy fuel in bulk or without a brand, for resale.

label: End-users and specialty
definition: The customer classes that use the product themselves, or buy a specialty product or service.

label: Trading counterparties
definition: The customer classes that trade with the company, product for product or on a buy or sell basis.

label: Branded jobber / marketer
definition: An independent reseller of branded fuel under a branded supply agreement, which owns or operates its outlets. The usual pattern is the Jobber role, a Fuel Supply agreement and sites branded through site brand assignments.

label: Direct dealer
definition: A dealer that operates a branded site under a long-term supply agreement with the company. The usual pattern is the Dealer role, a Fuel Supply agreement and a site brand assignment.

label: Wholesale marketing customer
definition: A customer that buys in bulk for resale, in domestic or international markets, under term or spot arrangements. The usual pattern is the Sold-To role and a Fuel Supply or Offtake agreement.

label: Independent retailer
definition: A retailer that is not a brand jobber or direct dealer and buys refined products for its own outlets.

label: Unbranded customer
definition: A customer that buys gasoline or diesel without a brand: an independent marketer, a commercial end-user, an unbranded distributor or a high-volume retailer.

label: Spot market buyer
definition: A buyer that buys refined products on the spot market, not under a term agreement.

label: Export customer
definition: A buyer overseas. Product is lifted at a coastal refinery or at terminal gates, and supply usually comes from a refinery or terminal site.

label: Terminal / Rack customer
definition: A customer that lifts product at terminal racks. Each lifting records the position holder, the customer and the carrier, usually as party transaction associations.

label: Forecast-driven customer
definition: A customer whose supply is planned from forecasts, not fixed orders, usually as an account facet with demand planning.

label: Commercial and industrial end-user
definition: A customer that uses the product in its own operations, such as a fleet, an airline, a utility or a railroad. The usual pattern is the Sold-To role and a Fuel Supply or Fleet Card Program agreement.

label: Asphalt / Bitumen buyer
definition: A paving or roofing buyer of asphalt or bitumen. Public bids and tax-exempt purchases are common. An agreement whose product scope is asphalt usually identifies the customer.

label: Pipeline customer
definition: A customer that ships or stores volumes under a throughput, storage or transport agreement, with invoices that flow back to settlement. The usual pattern is a Throughput / Storage agreement and party transaction associations on tickets and invoices.

label: Exchange / Trading counterparty
definition: A party that swaps product with the company barrel for barrel, or trades with it on a buy or sell basis, with differences settled as imbalances. It acts through the Exchange Counterparty role and is a customer only when a revenue-recognized relationship exists.

label: Crude oil customer
definition: An external customer that buys crude oil or refinery feedstock from the company. Part of these sales go to companies in the crude oil or refinery feedstock trading and supply business, or to other refiners.

label: Station
definition: A retail fuel station.

label: Bulk plant
definition: A bulk fuel storage and distribution plant.

label: Cardlock
definition: An unattended fueling site that customers use with a card.

label: Terminal
definition: A terminal where product is stored and lifted at racks.

label: Airport location
definition: A fueling location at an airport.

label: Pipeline delivery point
definition: A point where a pipeline delivers product to a customer.

label: COCO
definition: A site that the company owns and operates.

label: CODO
definition: A site that the company owns and a dealer operates.

label: DODO
definition: A site that a dealer owns and operates.

label: Tax identifier
definition: A tax identifier issued by a tax authority, such as an EIN or FEIN.

label: Public-company identifier
definition: An identifier of a listed or registered company, such as a ticker symbol or an SEC CIK.

label: Industry code
definition: An identifier or code issued by an industry body.

label: Legacy identifier
definition: An identifier from an earlier or another system.

label: Registered office
definition: The address of a party's registered office.

label: Mailing
definition: The address a party receives mail at.

label: Billing
definition: The address a party's invoices go to.

label: Operating location
definition: An address where a party operates.

label: Telephone
definition: A telephone number.

label: Email
definition: An email address.

label: Fax
definition: A fax number.

label: Order
definition: A sales or purchase order.

label: Ticket or BOL
definition: A movement ticket or a bill of lading.

label: Invoice
definition: An invoice.

label: Payment
definition: A payment.

label: Case
definition: A service or setup case, such as a request to create or change a customer.

label: Trade
definition: A trade captured in a deal: a buy, a sell or a storage rental.

label: Transfer
definition: A transfer captured in a deal: an exchange of products.

label: Core system
definition: One of the six systems the customer is created, recorded or executed in: SAP MDG, SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, RightAngle, Polaris and Dealer Master.

label: Integration
definition: An integration that moves the customer between systems.

label: Enrichment
definition: A system or tool that adds to or checks the customer after it is created.

label: Downstream
definition: A system that receives and uses the customer.

label: Landscape source
definition: Another system in the landscape that is a source of customers of a kind.

label: Create
definition: An attribute that defines the customer in the system: set when the customer is created there.

label: Enrich
definition: An attribute added to the customer in the system after it is created.

label: SAP customer number
definition: The canonical customer number SAP MDG generates; other systems carry it to point back to the MDG customer.

label: Business associate ID
definition: The ID RightAngle gives a business associate (BAID), which SAP MDG holds as an identification number.

label: Tax ID
definition: The party's tax identifier, such as its FEIN.

label: Legal name
definition: The party's registered name.

label: Territory manager
definition: The company's territory manager for the customer.

label: Class of trade
definition: The customer's class of trade.

label: Credit
definition: The customer's credit: its limit, monitoring, blocks and roll-up.

label: Status
definition: Whether the customer is active, blocked or inactive.

label: Business partner role and group
definition: The SAP business partner's roles and grouping, which set what the partner may do and how it is numbered.

label: Origin
definition: The system a customer of this kind starts in.

label: Setup
definition: A system the customer is created or activated in for this line of business.

label: Source
definition: A system in the landscape that is a source of customers of this kind.

label: Prospect
definition: The company qualifies a prospective customer: it captures the prospect and collects its credit application, financial statements, bank information and tax ID.

label: Onboarding
definition: The customer passes the credit and compliance checks and is set up in the company's systems: created and governed in the customer master, then replicated, enriched and activated in the systems that use it.

label: Payment management
definition: The customer's payments are received and applied, and past-due amounts are collected.

label: Risk management
definition: The customer's credit exposure is watched against its limit, with news and ratings, and holds are applied when policy says so.

label: Relationship management
definition: The company manages the relationship: account reviews, the annual credit limit review, the customer portal and the territory manager.

label: Offboarding
definition: The customer is suspended or closed and made inactive in the company's systems.

label: Prospect
definition: Salesforce holds the first record of a prospect, on the Trade or the CRM/Basic track. Jobbers start in Dealer Master and direct dealers in SAP MDG.

label: Master
definition: SAP MDG creates the customer, runs duplicate checks, applies authorization groups and generates the canonical SAP customer number.

label: Record
definition: SAP S/4HANA holds the customer's company codes and sales areas and serves as the accounts payable and receivable skeleton.

label: Execute
definition: The systems that hold the customer's record while its orders, movements, loadings and station sales are carried out: RightAngle, Polaris, Dealer Master, Terminal download and the card systems. Dealer Master aggregates station sales that other systems execute.

label: Settle
definition: Invoices and postings from the execution systems return to SAP S/4HANA.
